verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a full API reference in machine-readable form: a parseable OpenAPI schema with 174 paths, a plain-text endpoint and schema reference, and a keyless Developer MCP that gives live access to the API reference. Guides include working request examples such as a POST /bills request, and a sandbox API base lets developers run calls against demo data. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference UI where examples can be run in place. Missing for 10: a documented interactive try-it console in the API reference, runnable examples embedded in the reference itself, and independent hands-on corroboration.
